Exam Date & Time: 20-Feb-2023 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - FEBRUARY/MARCH 2023  
  SUBJECT: CIE 1072 / CIE-1072 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  (MAKEUP)  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE 1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Explain the term 'Tragedy of commons' with suitable examples.  
  (5)  
  
1B)             Discuss the limitations of traditional conservation measures and the role of technology  
  in mitigating them.                                                                       (5)  
  
2A)             List any five air pollution control measures used in Industrial Establishments.  
  (5)  
  
2B)             Discuss on the effects of thermal pollution on water bodies.  
  (5)  
  
3A)             Discuss with a case study any two eco restoration initiatives taken in India.  
  (5)  
  
3B)             Discuss how environmental protection is ensured under constitutional framework of  
  India.                                                                                    (5)  
  
4A)             What are the principles of eco-restoration?  
  (5)  
  
4B)             Write a short note on the seismic zone map of India.  
  (5)  
  
5A)             What are the responsibilities of the national disaster management authority (NDMA)?  
  (5)  
  
5B)             What are the environmental consequences of the Chennai flood?  
  (5)  
  
  
-----End-----
